findings.conclusion: 两路线首腿全部node实际RESULT0，全部48rank首步B1初始parity为0；已可读u1/u2均finite且fresh ratio error为0。完整Adam/RNG恢复资格仍以Root专属比较收据为准。
首轮FULL有113/128、LORA有55/64组含strict4且canonical≥.9候选。PG0分别21/13组，主要来自canonical全1；不能把PG0一律称失败或把近零PG标量称无梯度。
合法复用原D2资格首collection的64个真实TRAIN B1，父386/模型源/评分协议一致且所有rank初始parity0。3个B1零分中两路线均有2个找到strict-high见证；当前只是候选支持，不是训练后B1吸收证据。
真实A=(canonical−组均值)/(组sampleStd+1e-6)，没有第二次globalStd。FULL/LORA分别99/48个strict-high候选为负A；这是相对canonical排序，不能自动判错。初轮mixed组unsafe正A均0，但这不构成SafetyEP式严格安全优先数学保证。
非零sampleStd<.01的组FULL20/LORA8；组std会放大小组内细差，该权重与旧SafetyEP的globalStd不同。只说明设计差异，不能据首窗口认定有害。
FULL真实1.472810499B参数、LORA7.010307M；u1/u2均触发全局clip1。FULL preclip norm10.76/15.12，LORA1.14/1.69；不能直接由norm大小推出更新损害。u2最大allocated约58.399/26.908GB，FULL需保留后续余量。
FULL u1/u2平均update约14.06/14.67s，LORA5.47/5.55s；各自生成/评分另列。这是两次冷资格、不同B/world，未给出稳定端到端吞吐或等预算scope优劣。
优先看同一新run真实B1 TRAIN/NAV完整里程碑的零分修复与固定高分保持；持续记录referenceKL、clip/grad、strict-high得到A的方向及训练3step→部署10step差距。现在没有证据要求改kernel、阈值或停止任一路线。
FULL512组/4096候选中3组有严格NC/DAC/TTC通过替代但9条TTC0且canonical非0候选仍获正A；LORA256组/2048候选该计数0。此为真实canonical软TTC权重与严格安全门的张力，不是Gaussian实现故障；小前缀/不同B/world/θ更新不能据此判断scope优劣。所有实际case和A质量在bounded_formal_credit内，当前训练不变。

definition.positive: saved normalized advantage >0 exactly; no invented threshold
definition.unsafe: any NC/DAC/TTC !=1; overlapping marginal categories plus disjoint failure pattern
definition.scope: actual saved on-policy TRAIN candidates only, one actor version per collection

interpretation: Strict-high negativeA is a within-canonical relative comparison, not by itself a safety-credit bug.
Positive unsafe with a safe alternative, if present, is real canonical/strict-feasibility objective tension; canonical TTC has soft weight. It is not a Gaussian likelihood implementation error.
No rule or live objective is changed by this audit. Tiny prefixes cannot prove absence of this algebraically possible tension.
Positive normalized A indicates PPO credit direction at fresh ratio1, not a guaranteed trajectory improvement under shared parameters.
